cohort: 454 women who underwent hysterectomy for adenomyosis or leiomyomas
finding: Women with adenomyosis had a lower mean uterine weight, more pregnancies, higher surgical procedure scores, and more pelvic pain or pressure compared to women with leiomyomas at the time of hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Women with adenomyosis had a significantly higher history of Cesarean section compared to women with leiomyomas.
